Shared composition mounting, package writes in this HTTP surface, the five billing-oriented acceptance workflows and browser acceptance remain open.

scope.workflowBoundary: No acceptance-catalogue commercial workflow is claimed. commercial/invoices, commercial/entitlements, commercial/feature-catalog-plans, commercial/feature-subscriptions and commercial/feature-grace-recovery remain billing-owned and unverified in Rust. This slice advances the owner foundation: the current catalogue, Company grants/history, command-CAS revision and capability admission decisions.
scope.domain: Typed CompanyPackageOverview, CompanyPurchaseAdmission and CompanyCapabilityAdmission contracts. The overview carries the catalogue definitions, current Company grants/history, the same package-grant revision used by command CAS, billing mode and observation time. Admission carries the exact PackageDecision and allowed-by-mode observation without a reusable command witness.
scope.application: validate_purchase_request centralizes the bounded capability policy. company_package_overview reads the current Company facts, rejects any fact belonging to another Company, derives package_grant_revision and returns the catalogue snapshot. CompanyPurchaseAdmissionPort exposes read-only admission decisions. No command, receipt, audit/outbox event or packagedefinition is created by these reads.
scope.adapters: PgCompanyPurchaseReader retains its serializable transaction, Commercial source table locks and Company advisory lock. inspect_admission reuses the existing inspect path and projects the witness-free admission response. The overview uses the existing Company-scoped read plus package_grant_revision. No cross-owner SQL or new schema is introduced.
scope.http: Owner-local GET routes for /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/commercial/companies/{company_id}/packages and /purchase-admission. Exact Host/Holding targets, bounded and percent-decoded capability/purpose/mode query parsing, duplicate/unknown/control-character rejection, CompanyId validation, private/no-store/no-referrer/nosniff responses and bounded BusinessError status mapping. The backend receives typed transport facts and must supply the current Account/Platform authority, serializable owner unit and rendered context.
scope.transport: packages/server-commercial/src/adapters/native-company-packages.ts validates ERPX_NATIVE_COMMERCIAL_CONFIG (loopback HTTP only, reserved ports rejected through the shared policy, exact HTTPS Holding origin, unique hosts/slugs/ids, 250..30000 ms, bounded holdings), resolves by exact holdingId and incoming Host, forwards the actual session cookie and Provider assignment/context headers, bounds the response to 2 MiB, rejects redirects/malformed JSON/foreign Company/duplicate packages or grants/context drift and maps owner failures to explicit API errors.
scope.ssr: The provider Company packages page resolves the selected/first Company on the server, reads the native overview directly, seeds CompanyPackageManager with the exact snapshot and keeps the retained Provider context boundary. The package API GET route now requires the native Commercial transport. Unset or malformed ERPX_NATIVE_COMMERCIAL_CONFIG returns 503 NATIVE_COMMERCIAL_UNAVAILABLE and never falls back to companyPackageLifecycle.overview.
scope.purchaseAndIdentity: The Next page/route still requires the normal Account session and current Platform Commercial authority through the retained provider()/requirePlatformContext preflight. The transport forwards the session and current Provider assignment; the composition backend must re-check current Platform Commercial authority and the selected Company on its own owner transaction. A Company package grant never supplies Platform permission.
scope.notClaimed: No browser or authenticated page render, shared composition mount, package preview/apply command cutover, grant write, idempotency receipt, audit/outbox effect, legacy-grant migration change, billing workflow, provider/payment behavior or production acceptance.

cases: The overview returns only the selected Company grant and history, the full checked-in catalogue, the exact package_grant_revision, sandbox billing mode and observation time; a foreign grant is absent.
A grant update inside the owner transaction is visible to the next overview and rolls back, leaving state/version/revision unchanged on committed readback.

Admission returns allowed decisions for active grants, allows expired active grants only for settle-existing, denies new work after expiry, permits shadow/disabled observation and allows history from a retained right without exposing PRIVATE_GRANT_EVIDENCE or a command witness.
Empty capability requests fail with COMMERCIAL_CAPABILITIES_REQUIRED; a reader outside a transaction or inside READ COMMITTED fails closed.
The actual owner-local HTTP router reads the overview and admission over migrated PostgreSQL, including a foreign-Company path that returns only that Company source.

behavior.authorization: The Next page/route requires the normal Account session and current Platform Commercial authority. The native HTTP detail is intentionally composition-supplied: the backend must resolve current Account/Platform authority, exact Holding/Company scope and the selected Platform assignment before calling the owner read. No package grant or Company role creates Platform permission.
behavior.isolation: Every overview/admission read is constructed for one explicit CompanyId. The PostgreSQL reader rejects a different CompanyId, acquires the Commercial source locks and the Company advisory lock, and the application rejects any grant/history fact with another company_id. The HTTP router binds Host and Holding slug; the Next transport resolves the exact configured holdingId and validates the returned holdingId/holdingSlug/companyId.
behavior.versions: The overview revision is package_grant_revision over the ordered Company grants, matching the revision used as expectedRevision by package commands. A changed grant changes the revision; the read does not invent or advance a version.
behavior.clock: The overview observedAt and admission observedAt are supplied by the composition clock. Admission re-evaluates start/expiry/retention boundaries at that instant; the overview itself does not filter current grants.
behavior.idempotency: Not applicable to this read-only surface. No command, receipt, review token or retry mutation was added.
behavior.auditAndOutbox: Not applicable to this read-only surface. No audit row, outbox event, packagedefinition, grant or history right is written.
behavior.rollback: The PostgreSQL suite updates a grant inside an owner unit, observes the changed overview and aborts; the committed state and revision remain unchanged. The read path performs no write to roll back.
behavior.readback: The PostgreSQL suite reads the overview back outside the aborted transaction and the HTTP suite serializes the overview/admission response through the actual router; the transport test validates exact response shape and context drift.
